decisions.reason: It fits the firm's construction and transport equipment capabilities, and without a clear negative signal after launch the option value of staying in the market likely still exceeds the carrying cost.

An inclined furniture lift sits farther from the firm's core underground, construction and industrial operator niches, so after several years the uncertain upside likely no longer justifies continued support.
An inclined building material lift is closer to the firm's construction-site and lifting applications, so management would likely preserve this option while demand is still not clearly resolved.
A truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is both peripheral to the core customer base and relatively costly to maintain as a supported product, making resource reallocation more attractive.
